blocks.text: Scalability aur elasticity cloud computing ke aham concepts hain jo resources ko samajhdari se (efficiently) sambhalne mein madad dete hain.

Scalability ka matlab hai ke zaroorat parne par aap zyada resources jor sakte hain. Misal: aap ka online store hai jis par aam taur par ek jaise visitors aate hain. Lekin Eid ya 14th August ki sale jaise masroof dinon mein traffic (aane wale logon ki ginti) achanak bohat barh jata hai. Scalability se aap zyada servers jor kar yeh barha hua traffic sambhal lete hain, aur website sust ya band (crash) nahi hoti.

Elasticity is se ek qadam aage hai: system current demand (us waqt ki maang) ke mutabiq resources khud ba khud (automatically) kam zyada kar leta hai. Usi online store ki misal mein, jab website par traffic barhta hai to cloud service khud zyada servers jor deti hai. Sale ke baad traffic kam ho to system servers bhi kam kar deta hai, taake aap un resources ke paise na dein jin ki zaroorat nahi. Yeh automatic tabdeeli website ko achi tarah aur kam kharche mein chalati rehti hai.

blocks.prompt: Scalability aur elasticity mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Scalability zaroorat par resources barhane ki ability (taqat) hai. Elasticity mein system demand ke mutabiq resources khud barhata bhi hai aur demand kam hone par khud ghatata bhi hai.

items: Scalability: zaroorat par zyada resources (masalan sale ke dinon mein zyada servers).
Elasticity: demand ke mutabiq resources khud barhna aur ghatna; faltu kharcha nahi.
